nodes.name: Check USDA Eligibility
nodes.notes: NOTE: This API endpoint is illustrative. USDA does not provide a public API. In production, you would need to scrape the eligibility map or use geocoding + manual rural area database.

nodes.name: Geocode Address
nodes.notes: Use Google Maps Geocoding API to get state and county. Configure a credential of type 'Query Auth' with name 'googleMapsApiKey' and your API key value.

parameters.query: SELECT income_limit_1_4, income_limit_5_8 FROM usda_income_limits WHERE state = $1 AND county = $2 AND year = 2026

nodes.name: Get Income Limit
nodes.notes: Query PostgreSQL database with USDA income limits (scraped annually). alwaysOutputData ensures downstream nodes execute even when no rows match.

nodes.name: Save Lead to Google Sheets
nodes.notes: Store lead data for follow-up. Set GOOGLE_SHEETS_SPREADSHEET_ID environment variable in n8n.

nodes.name: Has Email?
nodes.notes: Only send email if applicant provided an email address

parameters.subject: Your USDA Loan Eligibility Report

nodes.name: Email Report
nodes.notes: Send eligibility report as plain text email to applicant
